# Crayon Roofing & Structures — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary

This corpus is a large bundle of concatenated call snippets, and the overwhelming majority are **not** sales conversations — they are internal/operational chatter: loading-slip confirmations, driver/location directions ("MFL தாண்டி ஆடக்கு போய் check post வந்துருப்பாங்க"), gate/watchman coordination, payment-follow-up/collection calls, bill-copy and e-way-bill/GST maintenance issues, and even a few unrelated personal/HR calls. Out of the full set, only a **modest subset (roughly 40–50 clips)** are genuine sales calls — rate enquiries, quotations, dealer/customer negotiations, objections on price, and order confirmations. This KB is built strictly from that subset. Given how thin the real sales-talk is, conclusions here should be treated as directional coaching material, not a statistically rich playbook — rates and terms quoted below are the *only* ones that actually appear, and nothing is extrapolated beyond them.

Crayon Roofing & Structures is based in **Manali (Andarkuppam, Chennai)** and operates as a **JSW metal-roofing-sheet distributor/dealer** — confirmed directly in one call: *"JSW metal roofing sheet நம்ம பண்ணிட்டு இருக்கோம். Supply பண்ணிட்டு இருக்கோம் sir. Fixing எதுவும் பண்றது கிடையாது."* [We only supply JSW metal roofing sheet, we don't do fixing/fabrication]. They are **supply-only**, not fabricators — a point repeated to confused customers who ask about shed erection or fabrication work.

## Products & brand ladder

Based only on what callers actually discuss:

- **JSW Color On Plus** (color-coated roofing sheet) — flagship premium line, AZ150 coating, available in 0.47mm, 0.50mm, 0.60mm thickness. Colors: sky blue, off white, grey, blue, red ("sky blue off white grey blue red எல்லாமே இருக்கும்").
- **Pragathi / Pragathi Plus** (JSW's lower-cost sub-brand) — AZ70 coating, cheaper than Color On Plus. Regularly stocked colors are only **sky blue and off white**; grey, green, brick red are NOT regularly stocked ("Pragathi-ல green color இருக்கா? இல்ல sir").
- **Indradhanush (JSW)** — another economy line, 0.35–0.45mm, sky blue/off white only.
- **Silver On Plus / bare Galvalume (AZ150)** — plain/bare sheet sold by kg, used for cash-and-carry trade.
- **PUF (Puff) roof panels** — 50mm thickness, sandwich panels with top/bottom thickness specs.
- **Polycarbonate sheets** — stocked, sold by piece/length (e.g., 12.5 ft pieces).
- **Decking sheets** — 0.8mm, 1mm, 1.2mm variants; used for structural/transformer-platform floors.
- **Flashing / L-flashing / ridge accessories** — sold per running meter (standard 2.5m length converted to "numbers").
- **Tata Screws** — self-tapping roofing screws, various sizes (1 inch, 1.5", 2", 2.5", 3/4" stitch), single-thread/double-thread/full-thread (FT) and DT variants.
- **Tata Welding electrodes/rods**, **CO2 welding wire/coil**, **cutting & grinding wheels** — allied hardware line sold alongside sheets.
- **Barricade/metal roofing sheets** for commercial site barricading (ad hoc enquiry).

- Pricing basis is negotiable between **square meter** vs **kg basis** — staff must always clarify which the customer wants, as confusion recurs across multiple calls.
